descriptions: This Arab West Report Interview Documentation Project dataset consists of 11 audio recordings (6 items) on the subject of Egyptian Antiquities in 1995.
The languages of the audio recordings is Dutch, English, and Arabic. The summaries of the audio recordings are in English.
